_doc: Completed T-0508 ledger (cohort 13 of the three T-0492 froze). Every one of the 76 manifest members received a dated review: an exact-name sweep and a justified surname-variant sweep across every committed corpus in this repository — the post-office and newspaper extractions, the 1833-1835 civic rolls, Fergus 1839/1843 and Norris 1844 and their crosswalks, the 1830 and 1840 census readings, the church registers, the land-sale entries, the Newberry index leads, the digitised books and the transcribed county histories — together with the source records this project already holds. Outcomes are here; pending is empty. Candidate identities are retained unasserted.
default_summary: No reliable record in the reviewed repository newspaper/reference corpus, the Chicago directories of 1839, 1843 and 1844, the 1833-1835 civic rolls, the 1830 and 1840 census readings, the church registers, the land-sale entries, the Newberry family-history index and the digitised county and local histories held here could be tied to this person with sufficient date/place/occupation/kinship discriminators. This is a documented no-corroboration result, not evidence that the person did not exist.
query_templates: justified OCR/spelling variants where the printed form was visibly suspect
search_scope: repository Chicago Democrat and Chicago American transcriptions, newspaper identity ledger and resident/source records
the six source domains scaffolded by T-0492 under data/research/ — civic lists, 1830 and 1840 census, church registers, books, directories
Fergus Chicago directories and the existing resident-research source registry
Cook, Will, Kane, Lake and neighbouring-county local histories
government, library and archival institutional records
